comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The part that stuck with me: Kilimanjaro lost almost 85% of its ice cover between 1912 and 2011, and most of the rest is expected to be gone by 2040. Mount Kenya sits 16 km from the equator and is down to eleven small glaciers. The Rwenzori had 43 named glaciers in 1906 and fewer than half by 2005. Sources are listed in the description if you want to read the surveys yourself. Is there a bit of ice or snow near you that older people remember being far bigger?
